plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Mathematics (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Of the 21 hours shown as University Core Curriculum, 3 must be from language, philosophy and culture, 3 from creative arts, 3 from social and behavioral sciences, 6 from American history, 6 from Government/Political Science.
[grid1 fn2] Select 4 hours from: ASTR 111 , BIOL 111 , BIOL 112 , CHEM 119 , CHEM 120 , CHEM 107 / CHEM 117 . The remaining 4 hours may be selected from: ASTR 111 , ATMO 201 / ATMO 202 , BIOL 111 , BIOL 112 , CHEM 119 , CHEM 120 , CHEM 107 / CHEM 117 , GEOL 101 / GEOL 102 , OCNG 251 / OCNG 252 .
[grid1 fn3] MATH 170 is highly recommended for math majors co-enrolled in MATH 150 , MATH 151, MATH 152, MATH 171 or MATH 172.
